title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: Audience Source Tape: Reel dubbed in 1979 by Will Boswell (3 3/4ips) from Jerry Garcia's personal collection. Original recording made by the sound crew at the soundboard; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Decent audience‑sourced tape of a classic 1973 show praised as the epitome of that year, but archival confusion leaves the recording quality unclear.
ai_review.review: The performance is lauded by at least one reviewer as a quintessential 1973 Dead concert, capturing the energy of a “smoking hot weekend.” The audio is an audience‑derived transfer (24‑bit FLAC) whose sonic merits are debated; reviewers note multiple versions and possible spectrum differences but give no concrete praise or criticism for this specific file.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks about the show’s overall vibe offset by unclear, mixed comments on recording quality and limited detail, yielding a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience‑derived transfer from Jerry's personal reel; reviewers discuss multiple versions with varying spectrum, some noise‑reduction artefacts and muted high end, but no definitive assessment of this file’s clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; only a general endorsement that the shows epitomize 1973.
